## Intro {.unnumbered}
Welcome to **Phy2Q Roadmap**. This is a living, open notebook tracing the path of myself learning the mathematics and computation methods that is used in quantitative finance. Beside, I found them also useful to extend my own research fields and have a deeper understanding.

It began as my handwritten study notes across the courses I've been taking and the books I've reade. I convert them in to this quarto notebook for better formatting, and something I can extend, revisit and share.
